empirical_basis: Formal Dynamic SBM generator with calibrated snapshot difficulty (rho=0.35), verified zero future leakage, and independent orthogonal community partitions.
closest_prior_work: Poursafaei et al. (NeurIPS 2022), Zhang et al. (KDD 2023)
key_differentiator: First benchmark explicitly designed to isolate historical recoverability after conflicting distractor regimes with calibrated positive oracle advantage.

empirical_basis: Empirical evaluation across T_B in {25, 50, 100, 200} demonstrating monotonic recurrent state degradation to chance (AP ~ 0.655 -> 0.505).
closest_prior_work: TGN (Rossi et al. 2020), DyRep (Trivedi et al. 2019)
key_differentiator: Prior work assumes monotonic drift or stationary streams; no prior work measures degradation as a continuous function of conflicting regime length.

contribution_name: Capacity x Distractor-Duration Response Surface (d_m x T_B)
empirical_basis: 2D grid sweep across d_m in {16..256} and T_B in {10..200} showing distractor decay dominates capacity scaling (beta_2 = -0.00043 vs beta_1 = 0.0144).
closest_prior_work: TGN (Rossi et al. 2020), JODIE (Kumar et al. 2019)
key_differentiator: Formally tests whether scaling continuous recurrent memory dimension resolves historical overwriting, proving capacity alone cannot overcome overwrite.

contribution_name: Continuous Compression vs Addressable Historical Memory Distinction
empirical_basis: Budget-matched comparison proving non-parametric addressable snapshot storage (K=1..4, ~2.75 KB) outperforms parameter-heavy recurrent GNNs (~100k params).
closest_prior_work: CRAFT (Yi et al. 2025), EdgeBank (Poursafaei et al. 2022)
key_differentiator: Directly contrasts online lossy recurrent state updates against addressable non-destructive historical indexing under recurring dynamics.

contribution_name: Exact EdgeBank vs Structural Retrieval Decomposition
empirical_basis: Empirical comparison showing EdgeBank explains ~65% of synthetic gain while structural retrieval captures community dynamics; EdgeBank dominates CollegeMsg (~87.6% AP).
key_differentiator: Disentangles exact pairwise edge repetition from higher-order historical community structure retrieval.

empirical_basis: Discovery of 4 empirical recurring interaction episodes where historical memory consistently outperforms continuous TGN under block bootstrap.
closest_prior_work: Poursafaei et al. (NeurIPS 2022), Rossi et al. (2020)
key_differentiator: Evaluates real-world dynamic graphs at the independent episode block level rather than treating correlated edges as independent replicates.
